caption:
What’s actually valuable now if everyone can build an app website or game? The answer is distribution and community.

#claude #vibecoding #codex #tech #ai
author: vibecodingiseasy
title: Distribution Beats Building in the AI Era
one_liner: When AI lets everyone build apps, distribution and community become the scarce valuable assets.
key_points: AI tools make building apps, websites, and games accessible to everyone
Supply of builders is exploding, collapsing the value of technical execution alone
Distribution — the ability to reach an audience — becomes the new competitive edge
Community ownership is now more valuable than the product itself
